positions.as_written: Repair tissue that never matches native cartilage, so a scan read against native cartilage reports failure in a success.
State the procedure and the interval before describing anything.
Use a cartilage sensitive sequence rather than a fluid sensitive one alone.
Assess the fill of the defect, the surface and the integration at the edges.
Assess the bone beneath, since marrow change and overgrowth are both recognised.
Assess the opposing surface and the rest of the compartment.
Repair tissue differs from native cartilage by design.
